mechanism: Donepezil (cholinesterase inhibitor) increases acetylcholine and may potentiate sympathomimetic effects of lisdexamfetamine, increasing cholinergic and adrenergic stimulation with potential cardiovascular and CNS effects.
action: Monitor heart rate, blood pressure, and cardiac rhythm; assess for excessive cholinergic symptoms (bradycardia, syncope) or adrenergic overstimulation; consider alternative ADHD agent if significant cardiac or autonomic effects emerge.
